purpose: Candidate organisations for linguistic/cultural review of the Bretagne regional companion and MotsPet regional layer. This register is not a partnership, endorsement or language approval record.

candidates.organisationName: Office Public de la Langue Bretonne

publicCapabilityEvidence.summary: The OPLB publicly operates Traduction-Conseil, TermBret terminology, digital-language services and linguistic review. TermOfis is the public terminology database maintained by TermBret.

candidates.notes: Presence in this register does not mean OPLB has reviewed EMOPET. Exact term approval requires the regional review-receipt gate.

publicCapabilityEvidence.summary: The Institut du Galo publicly states that it develops translation services, linguistic/terminological tools and expertise intended to support modern public use of Gallo.

candidates.notes: Gallo support must be evidence-based and geographically appropriate, not decorative regional slang.

publicCapabilityEvidence.summary: BCD is already the subject of a documented EMOPET Bécédia/Bretania access and partnership enquiry. No response or rights grant is recorded in this candidate register.

candidates.notes: OUTREACH_SENT reflects the existing controlled BCD communication record only. It does not establish response, review, rights or partnership.

promotionRules.responseReceivedRequires: inbound written evidence from the organisation
promotionRules.reviewScopeDiscussionRequires: substantive written or documented meeting evidence describing a possible review role
promotionRules.reviewScopeAgreedRequires: written agreement on exact review scope, deliverable and permitted representation
promotionRules.reviewReceiptRecordedRequires: exact term/content review evidence captured by the regional review-receipt authority
